pass_threshold.same_hardware: SGLang sustainable completed-request cost <= 0.90x matched vLLM cost with no worse quality/reliability boundary
pass_threshold.market_floor: at least 1.825 completed requests/s on the H100 planning case, or the matched current market cost target is not met
pass_threshold.interpretation: 10% is the promotion gate; the market floor is a separate campaign scorecard gate

immediately_executable_falsifier.hard_negative: typed none if exact revision/image/tokenizer cannot be bound, either workload arm cannot execute, raw outputs or telemetry are incomplete, or the route misses the 10% cost gate

later_quality_gate.consumer: raw serialized SGLang responses and hidden-state/logit captures from the exact runner
later_quality_gate.comparator: same prompts, greedy seed, stop IDs, tokenizer/template, and target revision under matched BF16 vLLM/Transformers reference
later_quality_gate.rule: derive pass/fail from raw files; require exact output-ID agreement for deterministic cases, finite features, parser/stop equivalence, and identity/disjointness mutation failures

evidence_limits: No local or GPU execution was performed under this $0 project contract.
The public H20 report is not a throughput or cost transfer to H100/L40S.
SGLang support is evidence for a route, not proof of exact revision compatibility or quality.
